name: B.Tech in Computer Science and Engineering
eligibility: 10+2 with Physics, Mathematics, and Chemistry/Computer Science with minimum 60% aggregate marks. Admission based on JEE Main / SPSAT scores.

name: B.Tech in Mining Engineering
eligibility: 10+2 with Physics, Mathematics, and Chemistry with minimum 55% aggregate marks. Direct entry options for JK Cement sponsored candidates.

name: B.Tech in Biotechnology
eligibility: 10+2 with Physics, Chemistry, and Biology/Mathematics with minimum 55% aggregate marks.

name: Master of Computer Applications
eligibility: Passed BCA/Bachelor Degree in Computer Science Engineering or equivalent degree. Or passed B.Sc./B.Com./B.A. with Mathematics at 10+2 level or at Graduation level (with additional bridge courses as per norms) with minimum 50% marks.

name: Bachelor of Business Administration
eligibility: 10+2 in any stream from a recognized board with minimum 50% aggregate marks. Admission based on SPSAT.

name: Master of Business Administration
eligibility: Bachelor's Degree in any discipline from a recognized university with minimum 50% marks. CAT / MAT / CMAT / XAT or SPSAT score required.

name: Bachelor of Design
eligibility: 10+2 in any stream with minimum 50% aggregate marks. Creative portfolio review and design aptitude evaluation required.

name: Ph.D in Computer Science and Engineering
eligibility: Master's degree in Engineering/Technology with minimum 55% marks or equivalent grade. UGC-NET/GATE qualified candidates are exempted from SPSU Research Entrance Test.
